name: Postmark
summary: Postmark is an email sending service focused on fast, reliable delivery of transactional email like receipts and password resets.

free_plan_covers.note: Free plan sends only 100 emails a month total, no overages allowed; Postmark markets it for testing, not real user traffic.

first_paid_usd_month.note: Basic plan starts at $15/month for 10,000 emails, then $1.80 per extra 1,000 sent.

portability.note: Postmark supports standard SMTP as well as its API, so moving away mainly means swapping SMTP credentials.

sdk_typescript.note: The official postmark npm package is Postmark's documented Node.js client and ships with TypeScript types.

setup.step: Create a free Postmark account and confirm a sender signature or verify a sending domain.
Install the SDK with npm install postmark.
Copy the Server API Token from the server's API Tokens page and add it to your environment file.
Create a ServerClient with the token and call sendEmail() from a server route.

builder_notes: Every send needs a confirmed sender signature or verified domain first, or the API returns a 422 error.
Use a separate Server API Token per environment (development, staging, production) so access can be isolated and revoked independently.
